7343.title: Running ACP command metadata is not refreshed
7343.rootCauseOneLine: Non-terminal ACP updates store refined command input without emitting refreshed item metadata.
7343.proposedFix: Refresh changed command metadata under the existing item key before output snapshots.
7343.caveats: Protocol-boundary reproduction, not live browser verification. Initial command uses the title fallback rather than an empty string. Reproduction patch and outputs are inline under reports repository policy.
